description: Multi-step warehouse-native pipeline compiled to one CTE-CTAS plan per sink. YAML-defined stored-procedure shape.

inputs.description: Upstream table(s) referenced by name in each step — no data passed

outputs.description: One or more materialized tables (one per sink), referenceable by name — no data passed

source.label: Source
source.description: Flat shape (one source, one ops chain, one sink): {upstream_table: 'schema.table'} or {kind: table|sql, ...}. Use 'steps' for multi-source.

operations.label: Operations
operations.description: Flat shape: ordered ops applied to 'source'. Supported ops: filter, with_columns, select, drop, group_by, sort, limit, top_n, top_n_per_group, dedup, distinct, union, join, sql.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Multi-step form. Each step: {id, source: {kind: table|ref|sql, ...}, operations: [...]}. Use 'ref' to consume an earlier step. Use 'op: sql' for raw-SQL escape (supports <<self>> and <<step_id>> placeholders).

sinks.label: Sinks
sinks.description: Multi-step form. Each sink: {from: <step_id>, table: 'schema.table', mode: replace|create_if_not_exists}.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

automation_condition.label: Automation Condition
automation_condition.description: Jinja-templated AutomationCondition factory, e.g. "{{ dg.AutomationCondition.eager() }}". Dagster's component YAML loader resolves it to the actual AutomationCondition object at load time.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (sample rows) for builder UIs.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True.
